sprint_snapshot.objective: Demonstrate the SpeakerCoach architecture with streaming browser audio, server-side transcription and agent reasoning, validated interview state, and visible server responses using the existing page.
acceptance_criteria: The existing browser page streams microphone audio to a local service while server processing continues; display changes are limited to showing POC controls, status, and results.
A real server-side Agents SDK agent consumes incremental transcription and returns input-dependent question and phase proposals that appear in the browser after controller validation.
The state controller retains the established question during an answer and rejects invalid or obsolete proposals; manual P events remain declared hints rather than proof of speaker identity.

Progressive replay uses the same downstream audio interface, excludes future audio and evaluator references from analysis, and produces a meaningful response before replay ends, with delivery and access evidence.
Start and Stop clean up capture, connections, and pending work; failures show degraded status while preserving the last established question.
The POC report supplies reproducible steps, processing and browser-render timestamps, observed results, and limitations; the existing benchmark transcript and timestamps remain unchanged.
